## Problem or need

Describe the problem this feature would solve, or the need it would cover.
E.g.: "I often need to do X and there is no direct way to do it with
bondebarras."

## Proposed solution

Describe what you would like to see implemented. Be as specific as possible
(TUI behavior, CLI subcommand, keyboard shortcut, etc.).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you considered and why you ruled them out.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps: screenshots, example use cases, etc.
